meta.revisionPolicy: Each indicator is final as its underlying source publishes; the compendium is a curated cross-source portrait, never a single survey.
meta.coverage: Percentage of Births Attended by Skilled Health Personnel (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
meta.note: MoSPI's compendium reprints this table from National Family Health Survey, NFHS-4 (2015-16) and NFHS-5 (2019-21), Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (IIPS); the figures are that agency's. This bundle holds one instrument only (NFHS-5, 2019-21); the indicator's other instrument is a separate bundle, never joined to this one. Values printed as "-" (no observation) or "NR" (not reported) are not baked; meta.omitted counts them.
